select.label: Select
select.description: Click a pin to select its Pin Path, exposing its geometry for editing.

move.label: Move
move.description: Press-drag-release to translate the selected Pin Path. Disabled unless a Pin Path is selected; commits as one undo step. Arrow keys also nudge it: 1 screen-pixel of movement per press, 10x with Shift held.

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.description: Press-drag-release to rotate the selected Pin Path about the point where the mouse was pressed, 0.3° per screen pixel (drag right to increase). Disabled unless a Pin Path is selected; commits as one undo step. Arrow keys also rotate it about the shape's own centre: 1°/10° (Shift) per press, Up/Left anticlockwise, Down/Right clockwise.

scale.label: Scale
scale.description: Press-drag-release to resize the selected Pin Path about its own centre (drag right to grow, left to shrink). Recalculates pin count and reattaches any connected threads to the nearest new pin. Disabled unless a Pin Path is selected; commits as one undo step. Arrow keys also scale it: 1%/10% (Shift) per press, Up/Right grows, Down/Left shrinks.

merge.label: Merge
merge.description: Left-click accumulates pins (from any Pin Path or layer) into a pending set; right-click commits them into one new pin at their average position. Esc cancels an in-progress Move, Rotation, Scale, or Merge.

selectionPanel.heading: Selection panel (shown when a Pin Path is selected)

pinDistance.label: Pin distance
pinDistance.description: The requested spacing between pins on the selected Pin Path. Editing it recalculates pin count and reattaches any connected threads to the nearest new pin, as one undo step.

geometryFields.label: Geometry fields
geometryFields.description: Live-editable numeric fields for the selected shape's geometry (position, radius, rotation, etc. — varies by shape type). Editing a field recalculates the generated pins immediately.

symmetry.label: Symmetry
symmetry.description: The same Symmetry controls as Pin mode, scoped to the selected Pin Path.

deletePinPath.label: Delete Pin Path
deletePinPath.description: Deletes the selected Pin Path along with its pins and any symmetry copies.

line.label: Line
line.description: Click a start point, then an end point, to draw a straight Line Pin Path.

arc.label: Arc
arc.description: Click a start point, then an end point, then drag to shape the curvature and click again to confirm.

ellipse.label: Ellipse
ellipse.description: Press-drag-release a bounding box. Hold Alt while dragging to constrain it to a Circle.

circle.label: Circle
circle.description: Press-drag-release to size a Circle Pin Path.

rect.label: Rect
rect.description: Press-drag-release a bounding box. Hold Alt while dragging to constrain it to a Square.

square.label: Square
square.description: Press-drag-release to size a Square Pin Path.

freehand.label: Freehand
freehand.description: Drag to sample a freehand path of pins as you move.

eraser.label: Eraser
eraser.description: Click a pin to remove that one pin.

pathEraser.label: Path Eraser
pathEraser.description: Click a Pin Path to remove the whole path, cascading into any thread segments that referenced its pins. One undo step.

polygonStar.label: Polygon / Star
polygonStar.description: A dropdown activating a regular polygon (Pentagon, Hexagon, Octagon), conventional star (5/6/8-point), or polygram (Pentagram, Heptagram, Octagram) drawing tool.

pinProperties.heading: Pin Properties (defaults, or the selected Pin Path's own values)

spacing.label: Spacing (cm)
spacing.description: The requested distance between generated pins.

actualGap.label: Actual gap
actualGap.description: Read-only — the real computed spacing after distribution. Only shown when a Pin Path is selected.

guideVisible.label: Guide visible
guideVisible.description: Shows or hides the underlying guide geometry line, independent of pin visibility.

modes.label: None / Horiz / Vert / Both / Radial
modes.description: Selects the symmetry mode. Copies are generated live and stay logically linked to the source pins.

interval.label: Interval (°)
interval.description: Radial symmetry only — angular spacing between copies. Accepts custom, non-preset values.

centre.label: Centre X / Centre Y
centre.description: Radial symmetry only — the symmetry centre position. Also draggable directly on the canvas; snaps to the grid while dragging.

draw.label: Draw
draw.description: Click a pin to start or extend a Thread Path (snaps to the nearest pin). Double-click finishes with a final segment; right-click finishes without adding one. Esc cancels/discards the in-progress draft; ArrowLeft retracts the draft's last point. Once the draft has 4+ vertices, ArrowRight auto-adds the next one by following the numeric pin-position pattern of the vertices added so far.

eraser.label: Eraser
eraser.description: Click a Thread Path to remove the whole path in one click.

segment.label: Segment
segment.description: Click one segment to remove it, splitting the path into up to two surviving fragments (a fragment left with under 2 pins is dropped). Pins themselves are untouched.

colourCount.label: Colour count (1 / 2 / 3)
colourCount.description: How many strands the thread renders as — a single strand, or a two/three-colour spiral. Geometry is unaffected.

swatches.label: Colour swatches
swatches.description: One colour picker per active strand.

twistPitch.label: Twist pitch
twistPitch.description: Only shown with 2+ colours — controls how tightly the spiral twists.

pinStateLegend.label: Pin state legend
pinStateLegend.description: Read-only reference showing the four pin highlight states: Normal, Nearest candidate, Active origin, and Used in this thread.

leftClickDrag.label: Left-click-drag
leftClickDrag.description: Pans the viewport anywhere on the canvas while in Pan mode.

snapToggle.label: Snap ON/OFF
snapToggle.description: Toggles snap-to-grid while drawing or dragging.

zoomInOut.label: Zoom out / Zoom in
zoomInOut.description: Steps the zoom level by ÷1.25 / ×1.25, centred on the viewport centre.

fit.label: Fit
fit.description: Resets the viewport to fit the whole board in view.

firstPrevNextLast.label: First / Previous / Next / Last
firstPrevNextLast.description: Jump to frame 0, one frame back, one frame forward, or the last frame. Any of these pauses playback if it was running.

playPause.label: Play / Pause
playPause.description: Auto-advances one frame per interval tick; stops (does not loop) at the last frame. Pressing Play again while already at the last frame restarts from frame 0.

frame.label: Frame
frame.description: An editable field — typing a value jumps to that frame (clamped) and pauses playback.

exportToVideo.label: Export to Video
exportToVideo.description: Records the animation to a .webm file, showing live "Exporting… N/total" progress. Disabled if the browser doesn't support video recording, or there are zero frames to play.

tabSwitch.label: Tab switch
tabSwitch.description: Two fully independent lists — a Pin Layer never contains Thread Paths and vice versa. The visible tab automatically follows the current Editor mode (Pin mode shows Pin Layers, Thread mode shows Thread Layers); Edit/Pan/Play leave it as you last set it.

eyeIcon.label: Eye icon
eyeIcon.description: Shows or hides the layer. Purely visual — hidden contents are retained and still function (e.g. still referenceable by threads).

lockIcon.label: Lock icon
lockIcon.description: Locks or unlocks the layer. A locked layer blocks all create/move/resize/rotate/erase/property-change operations on its contents; visibility can still be toggled.

nameRename.label: Name (double-click)
nameRename.description: Double-click a layer's name to rename it inline.

clickRow.label: Click row
clickRow.description: Selects that layer as the active layer for new objects and layer actions.

newLayer.label: New Layer
newLayer.description: Creates a new, empty, visible, unlocked layer of the active kind.

duplicate.label: Duplicate
duplicate.description: Duplicates the active layer and its objects with new stable IDs. Thread references to duplicated pins still point at the originals, not the copies.

moveLayer.label: Move layer up / down
moveLayer.description: Moves the active layer up or down in stacking/render order.

delete.label: Delete
delete.description: Deletes the active layer and all its contents in one undo step. Disabled when only one layer remains.

undo.label: Ctrl/Cmd+Z
undo.description: Undo. Ignored while a text field (an input, textarea, or editable text) has focus.

redo.label: Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Z
redo.description: Redo. Same text-field exception as Undo.

escape.label: Escape
escape.description: Cancels the active tool's in-progress action: an unfinished thread draft, an in-progress Move or Rotation drag, or a pending Merge selection — whichever applies to the current mode/tool.

arrowLeft.label: ArrowLeft
arrowLeft.description: Thread Draw tool: retracts the last point of the in-progress thread draft. Edit mode with Move/Rotation/Scale active and a Pin Path selected: nudges/rotates/scales it (see the Edit tab).

arrowRight.label: ArrowRight
arrowRight.description: Thread Draw tool: once the draft has 4+ vertices, extends it by extrapolating the numeric pin-position pattern of the vertices added so far, wrapping around the pin count of the relevant Pin Path. Edit mode with Move/Rotation/Scale active and a Pin Path selected: nudges/rotates/scales it (see the Edit tab).

arrowUpDown.label: ArrowUp / ArrowDown
arrowUpDown.description: Edit mode with Move/Rotation/Scale active and a Pin Path selected: nudges/rotates/scales it. No effect elsewhere.

shift.label: Shift (held with an Edit-mode arrow key)
shift.description: Multiplies the arrow key's Move/Rotation/Scale step by 10.

holdArrow.label: Holding an Edit-mode arrow key
holdArrow.description: Repeats the Move/Rotation/Scale step automatically after a 500ms delay, then every 100ms until released.

alt.label: Alt (held while dragging)
alt.description: Pin mode Ellipse/Rectangle tools only — constrains the shape to a Circle/Square. Releasing Alt mid-drag reverts to unconstrained.

leftButton.label: Left button
leftButton.description: Drives every draw, select, and drag gesture across every mode.

rightClick.label: Right-click
rightClick.description: Opens a radial context menu with icon slices matching the current Editor mode — Select/Move/Rotate/Scale/Merge (plus Commit Merge once 2+ pins are accumulated) in Edit mode, the Pin drawing tools in Pin mode, Draw/Eraser/Segment in Thread mode (or Cut/Back/Next while a thread draft is in progress), Fit/Zoom In/Zoom Out in Pan mode, and the playback transport in Play mode. Escape or clicking outside the menu closes it without acting.

doubleClick.label: Double-click
doubleClick.description: Thread Draw tool — finishes the in-progress draft, adding one final segment to the clicked pin.

leftDrag.label: Left-drag
leftDrag.description: Pans the viewport in Pan mode; press-drag-release also drives Move/Rotation in Edit mode and most shape tools in Pin mode.
